scope_summary: The user explicitly promoted the reviewed SX-VIS-063 terrain candidate, required current official research/implementation-feasibility/adversarial review for meaningful work, approved the SX-VIS-061 core-system board as a GitHub planning reference, and approved SX-DEC-064 active-route lighting. SX-DEC-064 adds only a procedural board projection rooted at actual train state: selected deterministic rails glow; alternate rails do not; lock is a separate overlay; terminal states do not predict future route. This approval records the project-local planning reference preservation and the presentation-only route-lighting implementation/test/documentation scope. It does not authorize terrain runtime integration, a production asset family, gameplay/data/audio/locale/progression/Base changes, T2/Issue #227 work, PR #174 mutation, a solver, or human/player/release evidence promotion.
